summary: Support and build on the Azure data stack: Terraform for infrastructure as code, SQL and serverless SQL feeding Power BI reports. Own issues in internal applications end to end — log-level debugging, error-code analysis, backlog work items, and fixes shipped with AI-assisted coding.
Phone and remote support for surveillance and alarm systems.
On-site IT support for private and business customers: internet, mail and printer setup, and hardware and software troubleshooting on PC and Mac.
Day-to-day support for people with disabilities — where I learned exactly where the line runs between the professional and the personal.
Customer service on board the ferries, serving passengers of many nationalities.
